column1: # TeX Live's manuals (ci/manuals.json) not identical at -j1 and -j4 when the gate took them (mc sweeps 77254, every manual at -j1 and -j4 with a 300 s limit, and 77264, its timeouts, kills and mixed results again with a 900 s limit, 2026-10-31, dev's crates at 6c9199131): the manuals shards run them and report them apart (known-red.txt), never red, and say one that is identical again.
